title: Getting unstuck

grammar.title: Negation: wrap the verb in ma ... sh
grammar.body:
To make a verb negative, put **ma** before it and **sh** after it:
| verb | negative |
| --- | --- |
| kanfhem (I understand) | **ma** kanfhem**sh** (I don't understand) |
| 3reft (I knew) | **ma** 3reft**sh** (I don't know) |
| bghit (I want) | **ma** bghit**sh** (I don't want) |
This is the single most useful pattern for rescuing yourself — 'I don't...' anything.

canDo: Say you didn't understand and ask someone to slow down or repeat
Ask how to say something, or what a word means
Ask if someone speaks English or French

items.note: 'wash' turns a statement into a yes/no question.
French is widely spoken in Morocco — a useful fallback.

items.english: how do you say this in Darija?

items.note: Great for numbers, prices, and addresses.
Disarms people instantly — they'll slow down for you.
You might hear it about the language — 'darija wa3ra!'
Extremely common filler: 'okay, done, that's all'.
